xml.brief: Remove caches from a cache list

desc.p: Takes caches off one of the user's lists. Codes that are not on the list are skipped, so sending the same request twice is harmless.

req.name: list_id
req.p: The id of one of the user's lists, as returned by services/lists/query. Another user's list, or one that no longer exists (e.g. deleted on the website), gives HTTP 400.

req.name: cache_codes
req.p: Pipe-separated cache codes (e.g. OC1234|OC5678), at most 500 per request.

returns.p: A dictionary with removed_count, the number of caches removed.
